title: Process for preparation of purified bioactive withanolide fractions from Withania somnifera and pharmaceutical compositions thereof
text: Standard solvent extraction yields complex botanical mixtures containing variable amounts of pigments and tannins. The disclosed PCT process utilizes liquid-liquid centrifugal partition chromatography to achieve pharmaceutical-grade purity without solid adsorbent fouling.
